title: Honeycomb SLO
description: JSON Schema for the Honeycomb SLO resource. Generated from the Honeycomb API OpenAPI spec.

description.description: A nice description of the SLO's intent and context.
description.example: SLO to ensure requests succeed and are fast

sli.description: Reference to the [Calculated Field](/api/calculated-fields/) used as the indicator of event success.

alias.description: The alias of the Calculated Field (also called Derived Column).

time_period_days.description: The time period, in days, over which the SLO will be evaluated.

target_per_million.description: The number of events out of one million (1,000,000) that you expected qualified events to succeed.

tags.description: A list of key-value pairs to help identify the SLO.

key.description: A key to identify the tag, lowercase letters only.

value.description: A value for the tag, must begin with a lowercase letter, contain only alphanumeric characters (all letters lowercase) and special characters of `/` and `-` allowed.

reset_at.description: The ISO8601-formatted time the SLO was last reset. The value will be `null` if the SLO has not yet been reset.

created_at.description: The ISO8601-formatted time when the SLO was created.

updated_at.description: The ISO8601-formatted time when the SLO was updated.

dataset_slugs.description: The dataset(s) the SLO will be evaluated against. Required if using `__all__` in the path.
